title: How To Fix Instagram We Restrict Certain Activity, Temporary Blocked Error 2026
description:
Hello everyone, here is How To Fix Instagram We Restrict Certain Activity, Temporary Blocked Error 2026.

In this video, I’m going to show you how to fix the Instagram error message that says: "We restrict certain activity to protect our community."

If you're getting this Instagram action blocked error, just follow the steps I’m going to show you to remove it.

As you can see, this is how the error usually appears:
“Try again later. We restrict certain activity to protect our community.”

This issue often happens when you're spamming comments on Instagram, sending too many messages, or performing actions too quickly—what Instagram considers suspicious activity.

If you want to fix this Instagram restriction problem, here are some simple solutions:

Wait it out –
Sometimes the best fix for this Instagram temporary block is just waiting. After a short time, try commenting or messaging again, and it should work.

Log out and log back in –
Logging out can help reset your activity.

Go to your profile.

Tap the top-right icon.

Scroll down and under Login, tap Log Out or Log Out All Accounts.

Sign back in to check if the Instagram try again later error is gone.

Restart your phone –
This can fix minor bugs that may be causing the Instagram we restrict activity error.

Clear your Instagram cache –

Open Settings.

Go to Apps or Applications.

Search for Instagram.

Tap on it, scroll to Storage, and tap Clear Cache.
This can help fix the we restrict certain activity Instagram bug.

That’s it for today’s video. If you're still facing the Instagram restriction message, try these steps over time to regain full access.

Thanks for watching, and I’ll see you in the next one!

title: How To Change Leverage On Tradingview Paper Trading, Set it to Maximum 2026 Easily
description:
Here I will show you How To Change Leverage On Tradingview Paper Trading, Set it to Maximum 2026 Easily 


In today's video, I'm going to guide you through how to change leverage on TradingView paper trading. If you're new to TradingView or just getting started with paper trading, this guide will walk you through the process step by step, making it easy to adjust your leverage settings to suit your preferences. Let's dive right in.

First, visit tradingview.com and sign in to your account. Once logged in, navigate to the charts section. If you're unfamiliar with TradingView, the chart section is where you can view live or historical price data for various financial instruments. It’s the core of TradingView, offering a variety of tools to analyze market trends.

Next, look towards the lower part of the interface to find the paper trading option and click on it. Paper trading is a fantastic feature that allows you to simulate trading without any financial risk. It's perfect for testing new strategies or honing your trading skills, providing invaluable experience.

Once you're in the paper trading section, locate the icon under the reply trading option. Click on this icon to manage your paper trading account settings. This is a crucial step as it allows you to customize your trading experience on TradingView.

You'll then see an option to reset the account. Clicking on this will clear any existing paper trades and configurations, giving you a fresh start. This is particularly useful if you want to test different trading setups or strategies under varied conditions without previous activities interfering.

With a clean slate, you can now customize your leverage settings. Leverage allows you to control a larger position than your account balance would typically permit. Adjusting leverage provides enhanced flexibility in your trading approach, so be sure to select a leverage level that aligns with your risk tolerance and trading goals. Experimenting with different leverage levels in paper trading can better prepare you for real market scenarios.

After customizing your leverage settings to your preference, finalize these changes by clicking the reset button. This action confirms your new settings and refreshes your paper trading account, enabling you to start trading with your newly defined parameters.

And there you have it, a simple yet comprehensive guide on how to change leverage on TradingView's paper trading platform. Whether you're a beginner testing the waters or a seasoned trader perfecting your strategy, customizing leverage in paper trading is a safe and effective way to refine your trading skills. Remember, as you experiment and learn, these tools are here to support your development as a trader. Thanks for watching, and make sure to subscribe for more helpful trading tips and tutorials."
